## Progress

- Open PR (branch feat/MDV-P1-008-add-staff): Settings -> Staff tab: staff table (name, role, location, second-factor state, status invited/active/suspended/offboarded, invitation state) and the Add staff member steps (role picker with descriptions, location, locked permission rows, invite through the P0 flow); doctors are shown in the picker with the exact redirect message and nothing is created (server refuses with doctor_redirect); resend (revokes the old link) and revoke invitation; custom roles = a built-in base role plus extra rows at practice admin's level, server-capped (no clinical rows, no staff administration, never above practice admin, checked again when access is read); each role change keeps before/after (SettingsChange) and a staff.role.* audit event in one transaction; every /v1/staff endpoint needs Config on Staff, roles, integrations (403 otherwise); a receptionist added here has no clinical capabilities; mutation-checked (ceiling, 403 policy); EN/HI/AR, RTL, axe clean, browser-verified against the real API
- Left: per-person working hours and one invitation for several locations (a person is added at one location; hours follow the location's opening hours), changing an existing member's role, deleting a custom role, and enforcing custom-role extras in endpoints that read the role claim directly (scheduling) - extras apply where access goes through IStaffAccess and in /v1/me/context

## Description

Settings → Staff: table (Name, Role, Access, MFA, Status) and "Add staff member": role picker with descriptions (receptionist, nurse, care coordinator, practice admin; doctors redirected to Add doctor) → facility scope and hours → permissions (locked rows from the role cannot be granted/removed here) → invite. Custom roles composed from capabilities.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Choosing "Doctor" shows "Doctors need licence verification. Use Settings → Doctors → Add doctor." and does not create a staff membership.
- [ ] **AC2.** Locked permissions from a built-in role are displayed but not editable; custom roles cannot exceed the capabilities of practice admin.
- [ ] **AC3.** The invite uses the P0 flow; the staff table shows invited/active/suspended/offboarded and MFA enrolment state.
- [ ] **AC4.** Every permission change is written to the audit log ("Every change is written to the audit log").
- [ ] **AC5.** A receptionist created here cannot open clinical endpoints (security test reused from P0).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
